review: First text pass of trade, crafting, living costs, jobs, recruiting and loyalty, including every pay, wealth, population and conditional loyalty row. Numeric and cross-reference verification pending; no runtime coverage claimed.

entries.acceptance: Track carried currency separately from stored funds, with actual location and access. Asset loss or transfer is an explicit world event; character wealth category is not a second cash balance.
Ordinary purchases need no reaction roll. Unusual circumstances may require one before the merchant offers terms; player-to-player prices are agreed directly.

World markets supply actual availability, currency, prices and barter terms. Goods transferred across worlds are commodities valued locally, not automatically legal tender at their printed face value.
Cross-world cargo and trip-frequency limits are explicit campaign choices and are enforced by transit assessment, not ad hoc removal of acquired property.

Locating a buyer may use area knowledge or streetwise. A merchant reaction and offer do not automatically sell the item: acceptance, funds, ownership and transport must be validated and committed together.
Treasure may require recognition, specialist buyers, lawful handling, preservation or transport. Define these constraints on the actual goods rather than awarding an immediate generic cash value.
The one-third-retail resale guidance for damaged military loot is an authored market valuation, not a universal resale floor or guaranteed buyer.
Starting self-made equipment costs full list price against starting wealth; crafting skill does not generate a creation-time discount.

In-play crafting requires authored materials, duration, skill and failure behavior. Parts are usually twenty percent of finished cost; occupied crafting time cannot simultaneously earn ordinary income or study credit under this procedure.

Ordinary crafting failure normally wastes materials; critical failure creates equipment that fails catastrophically on use. Record that latent fault and its concrete effect without revealing it in public preview.
A world may link wealth and status in either direction, both directions or neither. Apply only its selected relationship; do not globally reject wealthy low-status or poor high-status concepts.

Monthly disposable income subtracts the character's status-based living cost and noncontributing dependents' costs. Without job simulation, the campaign explicitly chooses adventuring-income payment or omission.
A job defines work, schedule, risks, affiliations, prerequisite skills/traits, roll selection, monthly pay and wealth category before employment begins.

Every required job skill needs at least one purchased point; a default score is insufficient. Minimums may be absolute or relative to the governing attribute, and trait requirements/prohibitions are also enforced.
At the end of each worked month, roll the declared specific, best or worst prerequisite skill with job difficulty. A job without prerequisites uses its declared fixed target or attribute instead.
Fixed-pay jobs pay normal salary on ordinary success or failure. Critical success gives a permanent ten-percent raise; critical failure uses the job's adverse outcome instead.

Variable-income jobs pay base on exact success, plus ten percent per success margin or minus ten percent per failure margin; critical success triples that month's income. Define treatment of negative calculated pay before allowing large-margin failures.

Critical job failure pays nothing at best and may cause authored demotion of at least ten percent, savings loss, dismissal, injury or arrest. Require a concrete outcome definition and commit each consequence once.
Adventure time is not ordinarily paid work; vacation or traveling work requires explicit job terms. Define partial-month settlement instead of assuming every started month is fully worked.

Typical pay is a campaign suggestion, with the adjacent technology levels furnishing the usual range. Exceptional rates require authored job terms; do not extrapolate missing endpoint levels silently.
Multiply the average-wealth pay/range by the job's wealth multiplier. Pay follows the job, not the worker's personal wealth, and independent income remains a separate contribution.

A worker in a higher-wealth job must purchase successive wealth levels as savings reach each next level's starting-wealth threshold, until matching the job. Preserve the advancement obligation without automatically granting free points.
Employer-based job seeking allows one intelligence check per week with laziness -5; self-employment does not require finding an employer.

A prerequisite exceeded by one skill level gives job search +1, by two or more +2. Other useful abilities can receive explicit author bonuses; resolve multiple prerequisites without multiplying an unspecified bonus.

Job-seeker advertising grants +1 at five percent of prospective monthly pay, +2 at fifty percent, +3 at five hundred percent, continuing by factors of ten; spend the actual selected budget once per search.
Job search subtracts twice the job's typical status; a status -1 job therefore gives +2. Simultaneous searches impose -1 on every roll for each additional job.
Hirelings are independently controlled nonplayer characters; payment and orders do not guarantee obedience. Preserve private statistics and distinguish full characters from incidental profiles.

An authored hireling may use an occupational template; adapting a heroic template can apply -1 or -2 attributes and skills. Specify the adaptation and recompute dependent values rather than blindly reducing every stored number twice.
Recruiting allows one check per sought hireling per party per week, using intelligence or an approved contextual skill. Multiple party members cannot each reset the same search limit.
Recruiter advertising grants +1 at fifty percent monthly pay, +2 at five hundred percent, +3 at five thousand percent, continuing by tens. This differs from job-seeker advertising by a factor of ten.
Offered pay twenty percent above normal gives recruitment +1, fifty percent +2, and double or more +3; this is distinct from ongoing loyalty pay bonuses.
An obviously dangerous job gives -2 recruitment unless the sought role is an authored combatant role.
Illegal recruitment gives -5, optionally waived for a streetwise search; critical failure still causes a defined legal complication even when the modifier is waived.
A successful search produces a candidate for an interview, not an automatic hire. Rejecting a candidate starts a new search; repeated attempts after failure depend on actual authored availability.
Generate loyalty from its reaction-table context at first meeting unless preset. Loyalty can affect interview truthfulness without exposing the true rating to the employer.

A secret three-dice loyalty check passes at or below the rating, and rating twenty or more passes automatically. Trigger it for meaningful danger or temptation, with concrete authored circumstance modifiers; do not import ordinary critical failure thresholds.

Failed loyalty means a specific self-interested action, not necessarily total betrayal. Forgiving a failed hireling with rating at least sixteen raises base loyalty by one; record the incident to prevent repeat awards.
Each ten percent pay above the role's norm gives +1 loyalty; the bonus lasts one month after extra pay stops. Track the end date rather than immediately removing it.
A noncombatant exposed to combat checks loyalty; failure imposes -1 for a week. Permanent consequences of repetition need an authored decision.

A rescue risking lives or mission prompts a reaction at +3 or more. On a good-or-better reaction, loyalty becomes max(original rating,roll result); serious injury or death in the rescue can justify an additional authored permanent bonus.
An authored end-of-adventure performance adjustment can permanently change loyalty by one; it applies once for that adventure.
At each completed service year, a successful loyalty check permanently increases loyalty by one; process anniversaries once across time skips and saves.
Only a setting explicitly permitting slavery uses the printed fifty-percent enslaved-candidate substitution; ordinary recruitment never enables it implicitly.

In an enabled setting, the base quoted price is five years of typical pay for the best job the person qualifies for, with explicit authored adjustments. The person remains a character with their own decisions and state.
The enabled procedure starts with ordinary loyalty and adds a two-dice result; confinement with no escape can grant an authored +1 or +2 to a specific check.
Jurisdictions separately define ownership, sale, transit, residence and emancipation rules. Crossing a border reevaluates permissions; no universal legality follows from the origin world.

Optional compact coinage: a small silver coin is worth four units, 250 such coins weigh one pound, and one pound gold is worth twenty thousand at a twenty-to-one value ratio.

Optional bulky coinage: an ounce silver coin is worth one unit and an ounce gold coin twenty; the printed example uses twelve troy ounces per pound and gold value 240. Keep troy mass distinct from the ordinary sixteen-ounce equipment pound.
